reasoningText.text:
Let me process this case. Familie Weber asks about U12 training times from September and where to find the fixture schedule. Jonas is presumably a member — I should check the register for Jonas Weber to see if he's registered.

Steps:
1. Look up "Weber" in the register.
2. Draft a warm German reply about training times and schedule. But wait — the club facts don't list training times! I must never invent facts. The fees are listed but training times are not. Hmm. The triage says "U12-Trainingszeiten ab September nennen und den Ort/Link zum Spielplan mitteilen (ggf. an den Jugendleiter zur Bestätigung weiterleiten)."

The CLUB FACTS are authoritative and I must never invent amounts. Training times aren't in the facts. I shouldn't invent specific times. I should say I will confirm the exact times with the youth coach/Jugendleiter and get back, or point to where the schedule is found. Hmm, but the proposed action says to name training times. Since I don't have them in the facts, the safe approach: reply warmly, say the exact training times for September will be confirmed shortly (I'll check with the Jugendleiter and get back), and direct to the Spielplan location. But where's the Spielplan? Also not in facts.

Rules: "Never invent fees or members; look up before updating; add only with complete data." Inventing training times isn't explicitly forbidden but the spirit of "CLUB FACTS (authoritative — NEVER invent)" applies to facts generally: "if a fee is not listed, say you will confirm." By analogy, if training times aren't listed, say you will confirm. So the draft should say: exact times will be confirmed shortly / we'll send them as soon as they're finalized, and the Spielplan will be published on the club website/member area. Hmm, but even the website location isn't a fact. I can phrase generically: "den Spielplan findet ihr, sobald er veröffentlicht ist, auf unserer Vereinswebsite" — that's fairly safe/generic. Better to say I'll forward to Jugendleiter and get back with exact times and the Spielplan link.

Actually, let me be careful: keep it warm, human, concise, max ~120 words, German, exact signature. Promise to confirm times shortly.

Plan:
1. register_lookup("Weber") — check if Jonas Weber exists. Maybe also lookup "weber@example.de". One lookup with "Weber" should return matching rows including emails. I could do both in parallel. They're independent, so I can call both in one block. Actually lookup by name "Weber" likely suffices. But parallel calls are cheap and allowed. I'll do one lookup with "Weber".

2. Based on result: if Jonas is in the register, maybe no update needed. If not registered, I shouldn't add — incomplete data (no birth year). I would note in the reply perhaps. If the lookup finds Jonas in U12, great — reply as usual. If Jonas is in another team or not found, still answer the question but maybe note registration.

3. save_draft to weber@example.de with subject "AW: Trainingszeiten U12?" — body warm German, signed exactly.

4. log_activity.

Let me start with the lookup. Since the draft content might depend on lookup results (e.g., whether Jonas is registered), I should do lookup first, wait, then draft.

Draft text (~100 words):

"Hallo Familie Weber,

wie schön, dass Jonas sich schon auf die U12 freut!

Die genauen Trainingszeiten für die U12 ab September lege ich gerade mit dem Jugendleiter fest – ich schicke sie euch, sobald sie stehen, garantiert vor Saisonstart. Den Spielplan veröffentlichen wir, sobald er fertig ist, auf unserer Vereinswebsite; den Link bekommt ihr dann ebenfalls von mir.

Sollte noch etwas unklar sein, meldet euch gerne jederzeit.

Herzliche Grüße
Sarah Verwald
Geschäftsstelle, SV Grünwald 1912 e.V.
(Entwurf erstellt von ClubSteward, dem Vereins-Agenten — vom Menschen freigegeben)"

That's honest — doesn't invent times. Word count ~90 including signature. Good.

Wait — should I commit to "vor Saisonstart"? Season is 2026/27. That's fine and safe-ish. Maybe simpler: "sobald sie feststehen schicke ich sie euch umgehend." I'll avoid over-promising specific deadlines. Keep it.

Also log entry: "Familie Weber (weber@example.de): Frage zu U12-Trainingszeiten ab September beantwortet – genaue Zeiten/Spielplan werden vom Jugendleiter bestätigt; Antwort als Entwurf gespeichert."

Let me run lookup first.
